description: This class, `PersonMergeLogData`, is a data container used for logging and serializing information related to merging person records in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It encapsulates various UUID lists for entities involved in a person merge process and stores prior state information about the person's demographic details.

classes.name: PersonMergeLogData
classes.description: A Java class representing the data and metadata related to a person merge operation in OpenMRS, including lists of UUIDs for various related entities and prior demographic information.

methods.name: getMovedVisits
methods.description: Returns the list of UUIDs for visits moved during the merge.

methods.name: addMovedVisit
methods.description: Adds a UUID to the list of moved visits, initializing the list if necessary.

methods.name: getCreatedPrograms
methods.description: Returns the list of UUIDs for programs created during the merge (deprecated).

methods.name: addCreatedProgram
methods.description: Adds a UUID to the list of created programs (deprecated).

methods.name: computeHashValue
methods.description: Generates a hash value representing the current state of the object for comparison or caching purposes.
